# [Sky-runtime](https://omega.gg/Sky-runtime)

## [Sky changelog 3.1.3](https://omega.gg/Sky/changes/3.1.3.html)

## Overview

This release extends ControllerCore with createPath, writeFile, getSaveFileName and removeWatcher
functions and updates saveImage and generateQml behavior. DataScript, Gui and ItemCheck receive
content updates, the bash scripts and README(s) are refreshed, and generateQml is wired into the
deploy scripts.


## Core

- ControllerCore: Add createPath function.

- ControllerCore: Add writeFile and getSaveFileName functions.

- ControllerCore: Add removeWatcher function.

- ControllerCore: Update saveImage function.

- ControllerCore: Update generateQml behavior.

- DataScript: Update reload function.


## Content

- Gui: Update.

- ItemCheck: Update check behavior.


## bash

- sky: Update deploy.sh.

- python: Update check.sh.

- Update README(s).


## deploy

- Add generateQml to deploy scripts.
